mira (DevEx): Quick note — discovered a reproducible onboarding pitfall in the JS quickstart paginator. When short-lived tokens + high client concurrency coincide with transient 429s, the sample app floods our quotas and the UI shows duplicate items. Repro is simple.

mira (DevEx): Repro steps:
1) Start quickstart with PAGE_SIZE=30 and CONCURRENCY=5
2) Set DEV_AUTH_TTL=2s
3) Trigger rapid pagination (auto-scroll) across ~15 pages
4) Some requests get 429 while auth.refresh() happens; sample retries the page worker which re-issues the same cursor across workers => duplicate inflight calls and quota spike

raj (QA): Saw this locally. Network log: same cursor requested 4-5 times within 200ms window. Server returned 429 to several, then multiple 200s with identical payloads. UI appended duplicates.

mira (DevEx): Extract from quickstart's worker loop (condensed):
```
while (cursor) {
  for (let a=0;a<3;a++) {
    try { res = await client.list({cursor, limit}); break; }
    catch (e) { if (e.code==='UNAUTH') { await auth.refresh(); continue } if (e.code==='RATE_LIMIT') { await wait(backoff) } else throw e }
  }
}
```

sam (SDK): Pattern retries at worker level; that lets multiple workers re-request same cursor when retries overlap. Two immediate mitigations: 1) move retry semantics into the HTTP client (request-level) and 2) add an inflight map keyed by cursor so only one in-process request per cursor.

toni (Platform): Also recommend SDK emits a short-lived "refresh in progress" promise that other callers can await with a bounded timeout instead of immediately retrying. This avoids token-rotation thundering.

quota-bot: [event] quota:table:items quickstart-demo exceeded soft limit 1m req/min at 2026-03-25T14:12:01Z

ci-bot: flaky test notice: quickstart/paginator.integration failed twice on main; reproduces with DEV_AUTH_TTL=2s in CI container.

raj (QA): I recorded counts: duplicate page requests dropped from ~120/min to ~8/min after switching to request-level retries + per-cursor inflight guard. No more stuck spinner in UI.

sam (SDK): Implementation plan:
- add requestWithRetry inside SDK http-layer; retry only the raw HTTP call, not outer page loop
- attach X-Idempotency-Key for list calls derived from cursor+limit when available
- provide a small SDK helper `inflightByKey()` that sample apps can use to dedupe in-process calls
- expose retryPolicy options in SDK config and add guidance in quickstart README about CONCURRENCY and AUTH_TTL

mira (DevEx): UX ask: quickstart should detect repeated 429s and surface a friendly hint: "Lower concurrency or increase token TTL for local dev". Many new users assume API is broken.

toni (Platform): We'll add a metric client.auth_refresh_retries and a dashboard to catch this pattern in early customer projects. Also recommend defaulting quickstart CONCURRENCY to 2.

sam (SDK): I'll open two PRs: SDK change (request-level retries + idempotency headers) and quickstart change (remove worker-level retries, use SDK retry, add inflight guard + README note). Will include a regression test simulating token expiry+429.

mira (DevEx): Thanks — please ping me when PRs link in so I can update onboarding notes. Leaving this thread for the repro record. :white_check_mark:
